name: Decomposition Tree
description: Left-to-right hierarchical tree with horizontal value bars and expand/collapse on click. Supports SAC data binding (multiple dimensions + one measure) and a script-API fallback.

data.description: Hierarchical data as a JSON string. Used only when no data binding is configured. Shape: { name, value, children?: [...] }.

rootLabel.description: Label for the synthetic root node when data comes from data binding.

topN.description: At each level, show only the top N children by measure value. Remainder is summed into an 'Others' node. 0 disables truncation.

defaultExpandDepth.description: Depth visible on first render. 1 = root + first level expanded. Deeper levels start collapsed; users click to drill.

lastClickedNode.description: Name of the most recently clicked node. Read this in the onNodeClick event handler.

setData.description: Sets the tree data from a JSON string. Ignored when data binding has rows. Shape: { name, value, children?: [...] }.

collapseAll.description: Collapses every node except the root.

onNodeClick.description: Fired when a node is clicked. Read property 'lastClickedNode' for the clicked node's name.

feeds.description: Hierarchy levels, ordered outermost to innermost.
Value used for bar size and node aggregation.
